Desai is the Mizuho Financial Group Professor of Finance at Harvard Business School and a Professor of Law at Harvard Law School. He received his Ph.D. in political economy from Harvard University ; his MBA as a Baker Scholar from Harvard Business School; and a bachelor's degree in history and economics from Brown University .
